steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: setup
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1'); s.enterRoomEditor?.(s.floorPlan.rooms[0].id); s.setCatalogOpen(true); s.setLeftMode('layers'); })()

steps.name: hide-first-item
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); const roomId = s.roomEditor.activeRoomId ?? s.floorPlan.rooms[0].id; const item = s.items.find((i) => true); s.toggleItemHidden(item.id); })()

steps.name: open-arrange-menu
